# Atypicals and mycobacteria

> *What happens when the usual microbiology toolkit fails?*

| Part of the chapter | Plan |
|---|---|
| The group in one sentence | Bacteria with no wall, bacteria that live only inside cells, and bacteria with a waxy wall that resists staining |
